notes.title: Update 28.08 – Shards of Change

notes.title: Patch Update: Matchmaking & Balance
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update packed with [b]features, fixes, and balance changes[/b] to keep your matches fresh and competitive. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h2]FEATURES[/h2][list][*][p]Matchmaking improvements for smoother, fairer matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now always have a [b]guaranteed 150-gold quest per day[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Rerolling a quest now always gives another quest with the [b]same reward value[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Card Upgrade Progression[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Harder to upgrade any [b]Epic or lower-rarity card[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Much easier to upgrade any [b]Legendary or Mythic card[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Mervena can no longer be played if your opponent played a [i]Doomed Spy[/i] on your board and sacrificed it on their last turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: The [i]"Win Ranked Games"[/i] quest now correctly works if your opponent surrenders.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2][p][b]BASIC UNIT (Buff)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Restless – Threefold: ATK 1 ➝ 2, Undying 1 ➝ 2[/p][/*][/list][p][b]COMMON HERO (Buff)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pachys The Cripple: All allies with up to 2 ➝ 3 ATK gain +3 ATK[/p][/*][/list][p][b]COMMON UNITS (Buffs)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Kauwn the Just: Strike 1 ➝ 2[/p][/*][*][p]Deathsert Bandit – Ambusher: Banish 2 ➝ 1 cards, gained ability [i]Execute 2[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]COMMON SPELL (Nerf)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shatter Morale: Return a card with up to 10 ATK to the owner’s hand. Cost increase 2 ➝ 1 (max. 6)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UNCOMMON UNITS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fuuri Igniter: Cost 4 ➝ 5 (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Noma Jhah: ATK 6 ➝ 4 (Nerf)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UNCOMMON SPELL (Buff)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rain Fire: Damage 4 ➝ 5[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UNCOMMON HEROES (Nerfs)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zirg the Unstoppable: Base Strike 2 ➝ 1[/p][/*][*][p]Fiera Olrac Ardnassak: ATK 4 ➝ 2[/p][/*][/list][p][b]RARE UNIT (Nerf)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vile Guard – Unleashed: ATK 14 ➝ 12[/p][/*][/list][p][b]EPIC UNITS & HEROES[/b][/p][list][*][p]True Face of Loyalty: Up to 8 ATK ➝ up to 6 ATK (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Mervena: Cost 2 ➝ 3 (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Beata The Tester: Bots slightly weaker. Strike 2 ➝ 1, Protection CD 2 ➝ 3, Looter CD 2 ➝ 3 (Nerf)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]LEGENDARY HEROES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ane: Recruits now cost 0 (Buff)[/p][/*][*][p]Ashen Anuran: Cost 8 ➝ 10 (Nerf)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]MYTHIC HEROES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Emperor Darteanesh: ATK 8 ➝ 6 (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Zedrax, Wrath of the Council: Now only prevents playing [b]UNITS[/b] and [b]HEROES[/b] that don’t cost 5. Players can now cast [b]SPELLS[/b] while this card is on the field (Buff).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Did you get here? Here is a gold code for first 100 readers! [/p][p][b]PROMO CODE: Gg5l9o4[/b][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for this patch!
As always, thank you for playing and keep sending us your feedback — it helps us improve Dfiance every step of the way.[/p][p]– The Dfiance Team[/p]

notes.title: RANKED SEASONS - UPCOMING CHANGES
notes.content: [h2]Dfiance now has Ranked Seasons. (starting 21.07 in browser and 04.08 on Steam)[/h2][p][/p][p] Players climb through the ranks, starting from Bronze IV, all the way through Silver, Gold, Emerald, Legendary, Mythic and unlikely Titan tier, receive rewards and keep pushing constantly for eternal glory.[/p][p][/p][p]  At the end of each [b]Season[/b], players are rewarded with awesome cosmetics based on how well they performed. When a [b]Season[/b] ends, player rewards and collected cards are moved to their Eternal slot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/1d5c0da0a42ed2fc16b89a0a58767ffb85aa237a.png"][/img][/p][p] When a new Season begins, player ELOs and Ranked collections are reset — allowing for a fresh start and giving new players a fair chance to compete in upcoming Seasons. [/p][p][/p][p]New Seasons can also introduce game-changing mechanics, such as [b]new factions[/b]. [/p][p]All cards collected during seasons, including player’s pre-season collections, continue to be available in the Eternal deck. [/p][p][/p][p]Players will keep all the cards they have, but they won’t be able to use them in Ranked matches, only in Casual, specific tournaments and friendly matches (upcoming). [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/3a42546b3cc85c0cf16533260662dcbada9e97ee.png"][/img][/p]
